newsitem.title: USA: MasTec shares Spain's Telefonica's gains.
newsitem.headline: MasTec shares Spain's Telefonica's gains.

text.p: MasTec Inc's stock jumped Tuesday, sharing in the enthusiasm surrounding its joint venture partner Telefonica de Espana SA.

MasTec gained 3-3/4 to 62-1/4 in afternoon trading, hitting a new 52-week high. Telefonica rose 100 pesetas 3.27 percent to 3,155 pesetas at midday. Telefonica has been a consistent gainer, increasing about 80 percent in the past year.
MasTec's stock often benefits from any positive news surrounding Telefonica, said Joe Glaude, an analyst with the Chapman Co in Baltimore.
"There's some optimism lingering from last week about Telefonica buying a stake in a Brazilian company. MasTec could benefit from any telecommunications infrastructure spending there," Glaude said.
MasTec provides facilities for regional and long distance phone companies and has several joint venture deals with Telefonica.
Latin American markets, which have limited telecommunications systems, are seen as fertile territory for growth, analysts said.
"MasTec has had strong earnings for the last couple of quarters. That trend is expected to continue," said Rankrishna Kasargod, an analyst with Morgan Keegan.
